title: Japan Scenic Trip | A Family Tale from Temples to Theme Parks
highlights: From Tokyo's modern beauty to Osaka's rich heritage, enjoy a family vacation in Japan, where top attractions and joyful moments together create a memorable experience.
Browse at Gotemba Premium Outlets, where unbeatable deals on 200+ brands and sweeping views of Mount Fuji transform a shopping day into a scenic escape like no other.
Hear the thunderous stomp and witness raw power as sumo wrestlers clash in intense best-of-three showdowns, bringing alive one of Japan’s oldest and most iconic sports.
Admire Japan's timeless beauty aboard the Arashiyama Sagano Train, a retro train that winds past the Hozugawa River and vibrant maple forests that change with every season.
Visit the amazing Nabana no Sato Illumination, where millions of LED lights cover gardens, tunnels, and water surfaces, creating Japan’s most stunning night spectacle.
overview:
About the Tour:
Experience the charm of Japan on this 9-day tour covering Tokyo, Mt. Fuji, Kyoto, Nara, and Osaka. Explore top spots like Meiji Shrine, Sensoji Temple, Tokyo Skytree, and the vibrant Nakamise Street. Enjoy Mt. Fuji views from the 5th Station, shop at Gotemba Outlets, ride the Hakone Ropeway, and cruise Lake Ashi. Visit Disneyland for a magical day, then travel to Osaka. Discover Kyoto's Fushimi Inari Shrine, Arashiyama’s scenic train and Bamboo Grove, and Nara Park. Enjoy thrills at Universal Studios and a magical Illumination tour featuring Kamagatani Valley, a train ride, boat rafting, and glowing lights at Nabana no Sato.

know_before_you_go: ID proof is mandatory for each guest at the time of booking and also upon arrival. PAN card will not be considered a valid address proof.
All international participants will have to share passport and visa details on arrival.
Learn basic Japanese phrases like "Konnichiwa" (hello) and "Arigatou" (thank you).
﻿﻿Remove your shoes when entering someone's house, a traditional house, or a temple in Japan.
Always remember not to leave chopsticks upright in a bowl of rice, as it's considered disrespectful.
Using your phone for calls during a train or bus journey is considered inappropriate etiquette in Japan.

The cancellation terms for any bookings or packages will be governed by the specific cancellation policy related to the land package. This means that any cancellations must adhere to the terms and conditions outlined in the land package's cancellation policy.

Thrillophilia's visa policy emphasizes that the company is not liable or responsible for any issues related to visa applications. This includes situations where a visa is rejected or delayed, or if there are any delays or errors in the documentation process. The responsibility and control over visa matters lie solely with the respective embassy.
Guests must note that entry ticket to Todai-ji Temple requires a separate fee of ¥600 per person, payable directly at the entrance.
For all the activities that have a designated common meet and drop point, guests are responsible for arranging their own transportation to and from the location.

Kindly note that hotel taxes range from JPY 500–1,000 per person per day for five-star hotels, JPY 200 per person per day for four-star hotels, and JPY 100 per person per day for three-star hotels and below.
Ensure your luggage does not exceed 160 cm in total dimensions to comply with size restrictions while travelling via bullet train.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Tokyo | Day at Leisure
days.desc: Welcome! Upon arriving at the airport, you'll be driven to the hotel. After you check in, relax for some time. Later, you can explore Tokyo at your own pace. You may explore Takeshita Street, famous for trendy boutiques & delicious street snacks. Alternatively, you can stroll through Edo Tokyo Museum, where life-size replicas & models tell the story of how Tokyo evolved from a small Edo-era town into a modern version. Also, you can try go-kart through real Tokyo streets at Street Kart Tokyo Bay.

items.title: Check-in at Shinjuku Washington Hotel Annex

days.title: Tokyo Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Today, head to Love Sculpture & board the transfer for Tokyo city tour. Visit Meiji Jingu Shrine, a sanctuary honouring Emperor Meiji & Imperial Palace, the primary residence of Japan’s Emperor. Also, explore Sensoji Temple, city's oldest Buddhist temple & Nakamise-dori Street, lined with traditional shops & snacks. Don't miss admiring the design of Red Tokyo Tower & enjoy vibrant vibes of Roppongi. Later, get dropped off at Shinjuku Station West Exit. From there, head to the hotel on your own.

items.title: Tokyo Sightseeing Tour - Departure from Shinjuku LOVE Statue (With Lunch)

days.title: Trip to Mount Fuji, Hakone & Gotemba Outlets
days.desc: From your hotel, head to Shinjuku Center Building & board the transfer for a full-day tour. Begin with Mt. Fuji 5th Station, offering views of Fuji Five Lakes. Stop at Gotemba Premium Outlets, featuring over 200 global brands stores. Also, enjoy Hakone ropeway ride, soaring above sulphur fields as you ascend to Owakudani, an iconic volcanic valley. Don't miss sailing across Lake Ashi on Hakone Pirate Ship, admiring scenic surroundings, before you get dropped off at Shinjuku Station's West Exit.

items.title: Trip to Mt Fuji 5th Station, Hakone & Gotemba Outlets

days.title: Day Trip to Disneyland
days.desc: Today, get ready for a day full of adventure at Disneyland Tokyo. Upon arriving, you can explore Adventureland, sailing with pirates on the Pirates of the Caribbean ride or exploring the jungle on a river cruise. Alternatively, you can drift into Fantasyland, home to classic attractions like Peter Pan’s Flight, It’s a Small World & the Cinderella Castle. While there, you can also enjoy lively parades, stage shows & later in the evening, fireworks that light up the sky with Disney magic.

days.title: Transfer to Osaka | Sumo Show Experience
days.desc: Check out & head to Tokyo Station & take the bullet train to Osaka. Upon arrival, head to the hotel by yourself & check in. Later, in the evening, get driven to Sumo Restaurant Ochi Izumi Stable for some unique experiences. You may begin by exploring the Konishiki booth or dressing up at Kimono booth (cost of attire not included), followed by the best-of-three matches in a sumo show. While there, you can also participate in a short sumo experience or pose with wrestlers in a photo session.

items.title: Transfer in Bullet Train (Shinkansen)
items.desc: 1 X Bullet Train (Shinkansen) will be Provided

items.title: Check-in at APA Hotel Shin Osaka Ekimae

days.title: Kyoto, Nara & Arashiyama Sightseeing Tour | Arashiyama Sagano Train Experience
days.desc: From the hotel, get driven to Nippombashi St. & board the bus for your tour. Explore Nara Park, home to free-roaming deer & Fushimi Inari Taisha, known for its red torii gates. Then, get driven to Kyoto St. & board the connecting train to Torokko Saga St. Sagano Scenic Rail experience, gliding all the way to Arashiyama. Disembark at Arashiyama & explore Arashiyama Bamboo Grove, famed for its bamboo stalks & Kimono Forest, a display of kimono-inspired pillars. Later, get driven back to the hotel.

items.title: Kyoto & Nara Sightseeing Tour - Departure from Osaka
Arashiyama Sightseeing Tour - Departure from Osaka

days.title: Day Trip to Universal Studios
days.desc: Today, get driven to enjoy a full-day adventure at Universal Studios. After you reach there, you can step into The Wizarding World of Harry Potter or dive into the colorful world of Super Nintendo World. You can also visit Minion Park for playful rides & games or head into the prehistoric landscape of Jurassic Park & take on The Flying Dinosaur, a high-speed suspended coaster that soars above the park. After a fun-filled day, get driven back to the hotel.

days.title: Sakura Magic & Nabana no Sato Illumination Tour
days.desc: Head to Daikokucho St. & take a train to Mainichi Newspaper Building. Upon arriving, enjoy a tasty sukiyaki lunch in Sekigahara, followed by a visit to Kamagatani Valley for a photo stop. Then take the Yoro Rail train from Yoro St. to Oakgi St. & enjoy a scenic countryside ride, followed by the Ogaki rafting experience. Lastly, visit Nabana no Sato, where flower gardens & Tunnel of Lights create a memorable time. Later, take a train back to Osaka & from there head to the hotel on your own.

items.title: Sakura Magic & Nabana no Sato Tour

days.title: Departure Day
days.desc: After checking out, you'll be transferred to Kansai International Airport to catch your flight back home. Take this time to reflect on the unforgettable memories created during your journey, from discovering lively cityscapes & ancient temples to experiencing exciting theme parks & breathtaking natural beauty.
